newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate up, baht strengthens late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate up, baht strengthens late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate edged up to 12.00 percent late on Friday following high demand for funds to buy dollars, dealers said.
"The buying of dollars drove up the interbank rate. Lenders were willing to offer rates at between 11.75-12.00 percent only," said a dealer at Citibank.
The interbank overnight rate was quoted at 11.50 percent this morning and 11.50-11.75 percent late Thursday.
The baht strengthened against the dollar to 25.560-25.565 from 25.565-25.568 early in line with decline in dollar against major currencies in the European market, the dealer said.
"Although the baht gained there was still heavy buying of the dollar," the dealer said.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was at 9.80/10.80 satangs per dollar versus 9.90/10.50 satangs in the morning.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the dollar/baht mid-rate at 25.53 against 25.51 on Thursday.
